id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

queueTypeId.description: The ID of the queue type where the entry with the errors are located.

targetTypeId.description: Target type ID for the entry that has the error.

targetObjId.description: Target object ID for the entry that has the error.

entryType.description: Entry type for the entry that has the error.

context.description: Context for the entry that has the error.

priority.description: Priority for the entry that has the error.

nodePool.description: Node pool for the entry that has the error.

errorCode.description: Primary error code for the error.

entryId.description: Id of queue entry that has the error.

invalidatedAt.description: Invalidation timestamp for the entry that has the error.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the error was added.

entry.description: Complete queue entry in the state it was in when the error occurred.

detail.description: Details of the error that the entry is for.

review.description:
If reviewed, the review for the entry and null otherwise.  All entries in a group being reviewed will have the
same value.

title:
Invalidation queue entry error details. There will be at most one error entry for a queue entry. This will be
enforced by having a unique index on the queueTypeId/entryId and using a hash of those values as the ID value.
name: InvalidationQueueError
